sources.entry: MuAPI - Generative media API for image, video, and audio models, with OpenAI-compatible chat and image endpoints. #paid #api

summary.name: MuAPI
summary.one_liner: MuAPI is a generative media API platform that gives developers one endpoint for image, video, and audio models such as FLUX, Kling, and Seedance.
use_cases: integrate image generation into an app
add audio generation to a product
compare multiple generative models behind one API
reduce cost of calling AI media models
summary.what_it_does: The page describes MuAPI as a single API for image, video, and audio generation, with access to 500+ AI models (the body text also cites 250+ optimized models). Named model families include FLUX, Kling, Seedance, Nano Banana, and GPT Image. The page says it has no subscription and that failed tasks are not charged. It also advertises lower cost than direct provider APIs and promotes Seedance 2 and Seedance 2.5 Flash. A directory listing mentions OpenAI-compatible chat and image endpoints.
notable: Single API covering 500+ image, video, and audio models
No subscription; failed tasks are not charged
OpenAI-compatible chat and image endpoints (per directory listing)
Advertises lower cost than direct provider APIs
caveats: Usage is metered per task; the page does not state detailed per-model prices
Model counts differ on the page (500+ in header, 250+ in body)
Discount and deal promotions are time-limited
